rules.quote: use direct voice
rules.rule: Respond using direct voice.

rules.quote: keep responses concise and direct
rules.rule: Keep responses concise and direct.

rules.quote: Active/direct voice.
rules.rule: Write in active/direct voice.

rules.quote: Short.
rules.rule: Keep responses short.

rules.quote: Cut preamble and restating.
rules.rule: Cut preamble and do not restate what was already said.

rules.quote: State the point, then stop.
rules.rule: State the point, then stop.

rules.quote: Applies to written deliverables too (DECISIONS.md etc.)
rules.rule: Apply the same conciseness to written deliverables such as DECISIONS.md.

rules.quote: keep entries modular and concise with a clear explanation, not long over-written prose
rules.rule: In written deliverables, keep entries modular and concise with a clear explanation rather than long over-written prose.

rules.quote: DECISIONS.md entries must read like a real decision/discussion between the user and me — NOT a description of what the thing is.
rules.rule: Write DECISIONS.md entries as a real decision/discussion between the user and the AI, not as a description of what the thing is.

rules.quote: Each entry, concise, in the user's first-person voice
rules.rule: Write each DECISIONS.md entry concisely and in the user's first-person voice.

rules.quote: who proposed it ("my call" / "Claude proposed")
rules.rule: In each DECISIONS.md entry, state who proposed the decision (e.g., "my call" or "Claude proposed").

rules.quote: what the user pushed back on
rules.rule: In each DECISIONS.md entry, state what the user pushed back on.

rules.quote: what they agreed / didn't agree on
rules.rule: In each DECISIONS.md entry, state what the user and AI agreed or did not agree on.

rules.quote: the trade-off
rules.rule: In each DECISIONS.md entry, include the trade-off.

rules.quote: and the reason.
rules.rule: In each DECISIONS.md entry, include the reason for the decision.

rules.quote: write each entry as a short narrative of the back-and-forth
rules.rule: Write each DECISIONS.md entry as a short narrative of the back-and-forth.

rules.quote: Keep it concise.
rules.rule: Keep each DECISIONS.md entry concise.

rules.quote: Every commit needs the user's approval
rules.rule: Obtain the user's explicit approval before making any commit, whether it contains docs or code.

rules.quote: Stage/prepare, then wait for the go before committing.
rules.rule: Stage and prepare changes, then wait for the user's go-ahead before committing.

rules.quote: Docs / decisions / planning / non-code: commit on the current branch
rules.rule: Commit docs, decisions, planning, and other non-code changes on the current branch without checking out a new branch.

rules.quote: Code: on its own dedicated branch.
rules.rule: Commit code changes only on a dedicated branch created for that work.

rules.quote: Never work code directly on `main`/`master`
rules.rule: Never write or commit code directly on the main or master branch.

rules.quote: check out a branch and commit there after approval.
rules.rule: Check out a branch for code changes and commit there only after receiving approval.

rules.quote: Never delete branches
rules.rule: Never delete git branches.

rules.quote: leave merged branches in place
rules.rule: Leave merged branches in place rather than removing them.

rules.quote: Pushing to a remote needs approval regardless of what changed.
rules.rule: Obtain approval before pushing to a remote, regardless of what changed.

rules.quote: Always wait for approval before any commit.
rules.rule: Always wait for the user's approval before making any commit.

rules.quote: Never read, open, `cat`, or `sed` the user's `.env` file
rules.rule: Never read, open, `cat`, or `sed` the user's `.env` file.

rules.quote: Never edit `.env` either.
rules.rule: Never edit the user's `.env` file.

rules.quote: To tell the user what to change, edit `.env.example` (the safe committed template) with the right values + comments, or explain in chat
rules.rule: To tell the user what config or secret changes to make, edit `.env.example` with the right values and comments, or explain the change in chat.

rules.quote: for any env/config fix, update `.env.example` or describe the change in chat — never touch the real `.env`.
rules.rule: For any env/config fix, update `.env.example` or describe the change in chat, and never touch the real `.env`.

rules.quote: User wants scaffolding done through official generators (e.g. `create-next-app`), not hand-written.
rules.rule: Scaffold projects using official generators such as create-next-app instead of hand-writing the scaffolding.

rules.quote: Do everything through the generator
rules.rule: Perform all scaffolding work through the official generator.

rules.quote: keep its files
rules.rule: Keep the files produced by the official generator.

rules.quote: then only UPDATE or ADD what's project-specific on top
rules.rule: After generating, only update or add project-specific changes on top of the generated files.

rules.quote: don't substitute hand-rolled versions of files the generator provides (configs, layout, page, globals.css, etc.)
rules.rule: Do not replace generator-provided files such as configs, layout, page, or globals.css with hand-rolled versions.

rules.quote: run the generator with the right flags
rules.rule: Run the official generator with the appropriate flags.

rules.quote: keep its output
rules.rule: Keep the output produced by the official generator.

rules.quote: layer project code/config on top
rules.rule: Layer project-specific code and configuration on top of the generated output.

rules.quote: the user wants me to note/track their decisions as we make them throughout the conversation
rules.rule: During the Gradion assessment work, note and track the user's decisions as they are made throughout the conversation.

rules.quote: but only decisions related to the project, not everything
rules.rule: Track only decisions related to the project, not every decision.

rules.quote: Record a decision only AFTER the user explicitly confirms it
rules.rule: Record a decision only after the user explicitly confirms it.

rules.quote: never mid-discussion or from my own proposal the user hasn't accepted
rules.rule: Never record a decision mid-discussion or from your own proposal that the user has not accepted.

rules.quote: Once confirmed, record it (DECISIONS.md entry).
rules.rule: Once a decision is confirmed, record it as an entry in DECISIONS.md.

rules.quote: Do not log trivia or non-project chatter.
rules.rule: Do not log trivia or non-project chatter.

rules.quote: Always capture the REASONING behind each decision, both sides
rules.rule: Always capture the reasoning behind each decision, from both sides.

rules.quote: when the user pushes back or makes their own call, record their reasoning
rules.rule: When the user pushes back or makes their own call, record the user's reasoning.

rules.quote: when the user accepts my proposal, record my reasoning too
rules.rule: When the user accepts your proposal, record your reasoning too.

rules.quote: Every entry should say why, not just what
rules.rule: Every decision entry should state why, not just what.

rules.quote: the user wants me as a coworker/copilot, not an order-taker
rules.rule: On this project, act as a coworker/copilot who collaborates, not as an order-taker.

rules.quote: Engage as a peer
rules.rule: Engage with the user as a peer rather than as a subordinate.

rules.quote: take positions
rules.rule: Take clear positions on the work instead of staying neutral.

rules.quote: discuss trade-offs
rules.rule: Discuss trade-offs explicitly when working through decisions.

rules.quote: push back
rules.rule: Push back when you disagree rather than silently complying.

rules.quote: not by me just listing options and awaiting orders
rules.rule: Do not merely list options and wait for orders; participate in deciding.

rules.quote: Take a stance and argue it briefly
rules.rule: Take a stance and argue for it briefly.

rules.quote: invite pushback
rules.rule: Invite the user to push back on your stance.

rules.quote: converge together
rules.rule: Converge on a decision together with the user.

rules.quote: Avoid dumping every option as a checklist.
rules.rule: Avoid dumping every option as a checklist.
